metadata.description: Mods for this repo's Claude Code setup.

plugins.name: caveman-mod
plugins.description: Caveman ultracave style, always on: injected at session start, on every message and into every subagent. No modes, no buttons.

plugins.name: codebase-memory-mod
plugins.description: codebase-memory-mcp for Claude Code: MCP server, skill, and hooks that put the graph first in every chat and subagent, with a gate on grep for indexed code.

plugins.name: rea-mod
plugins.description: REA reverse engineering for Claude Code: MCP server, skill and analysis engines (JDK 21, Ghidra, jadx, Apktool) installed by the mod on first use, kept on rea-agents' latest release.

plugins.name: authentik-mod
plugins.description: authentik 2026.8 management for Claude Code: MCP server with tools for users, groups, SSO apps and providers, flows, policies, RBAC, blueprints, branding and more. URL and token asked at install (token in the keychain), safe by default.

plugins.name: mcptoon-mod
plugins.description: Deprecated: replaced by oh-my-context-mod. Version 0.1.1 only puts back what 0.1.0 changed; install oh-my-context-mod, then uninstall this.

plugins.name: oh-my-context-mod
plugins.description: Routes every plugin and user MCP server through one oh-my-context gateway (bundled, nothing downloaded) and lists skills by name only, so they stop filling the context while everything still works. Sets itself up on enable and puts everything back on disable or uninstall. /oh-my-context-mod shows what moved and turns it off.
